sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
Prof. S. M. Gawande Vice-President, Alumni Association of APCOER 8275401266 sagar.gawande@abmspcoerpune.org linkedin.com/in/sagar-gawande-366558151
As the Vice-President of our Alumni Association, I am delighted to have the opportunity to interact with all alumna and express my appreciation for your continued engagement with our association. Our Alumni Association exists to facilitate lifelong connections among alumni, promote professional and personal development, and support the mission and goals of our alma mater. We are committed to providing our members with valuable resources and opportunities to connect, learn, and grow. As Vice President, my vision is to foster a culture of mentorship and knowledge-sharing within our alumni community. Each one of us has a unique story to tell, a journey replete with lessons, triumphs, and challenges. By sharing these experiences, we uplift one another, provide guidance to those embarking on similar paths, and collectively contribute to the growth of our community.
